# Helvety Image Upscaler

> Upscale PNG, JPEG, or WebP in your browser on your device. AI quality when supported, with sensible limits so tabs stay responsive. No image upload to Helvety servers in the normal flow. MIT-licensed, Swiss-built.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler): Main application route

## Crawling And Indexing
- The public image upscaler route is intended to be crawlable and indexable.
